basic_info.description: Opportunity Knocks! 6 Units in 2 buildings, in a prime Duboce Triangle / Wiggle location! Unit makeup includes 2 x 2 bed/1 ba, 3 x 1 bd/1 ba and 1 studio. Buildings share a common garden/patio.  Within 2 blocks are 5 MUNI/Metro lines, Tech Shuttles, 3 Grocery stores, Duboce Park and the Wiggle. 12 GRM!
